race.comment: SIMPLY STEFFI (11) is of interest given the class drop from the G3 Scarborough Stakes, where she was clearly out of her depth and unwanted in betting. Her Sandown-Hillside run two back in BM66 grade had more merit than the margin, with an awkward start and late traffic, and she now gets back to a distance at which she has won. SHARING MOMENTS (4) is a major danger with a strong overall record, proven 1000m form and a prior win at this venue, while her Cranbourne fresh run came in BM66 grade and this looks a more suitable assignment with D Lane happy to stay aboard. LES BRAVES (1) brings winning form after beating BIFROST at Ballarat and still appeals despite rising from BM56 grade. WATTEN ASSETT (6) is consistent and an each way chance.
